summary: Re-validation of two fixes from iteration_1. Both PASS. (1) Backend POST /api/ai/insights with scope=ejecutivo now returns 200 with non-empty insight (model changed to gpt-4o). (2) Frontend /territorial: Leaflet map renders unconditionally with exactly 1 .leaflet-container and 125 markers; no 'Map container is already initialized' error; no CRA runtime error overlay; navigating away and back to /territorial repeatedly keeps a single container. Smoke test (login + executive dashboard + filters) also works.
critical_code_review_comments: ai_router.py line 86 still hardcodes model: 'gpt-5.4' in the empty-context early-return payload (cosmetic only, but inconsistent with the actual gpt-4o model now used). Recommend changing to 'gpt-4o' for consistency.
Territorial.jsx now renders MapContainer unconditionally with overlay loader (good). The fix correctly addresses Leaflet's _initContainer assertion.

success_rate.backend: 100% (AI insights + login + dashboards + filters all pass)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (territorial map renders, navigation stable, smoke OK)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Both regression fixes from iteration_1 are confirmed working. Backend pytest TestAI::test_insights_ejecutivo passes in ~6s. Frontend Territorial map verified: 1 leaflet-container, 125 leaflet-interactive markers, no error overlays after navigating /, /academico, /historico repeatedly. Only minor cleanup left: ai_router.py line 86 still labels model 'gpt-5.4' in the empty-context branch.
rca of the issue: Iteration_1 root causes were correctly mitigated: (a) Replacing model with .with_model('openai','gpt-4o') resolved the litellm 'Invalid model name' 500. (b) Rendering <MapContainer> unconditionally with the Skeleton as an absolute pointer-events:none overlay (Territorial.jsx) plus removing React.StrictMode (index.js) prevented Leaflet's double-init on the same DOM node.
